verifier.suspected_mechanism: earned() is declared public and mutates state — it writes tokenClaimedPerEpoch as it walks epochs but never pays out or advances lastEarn, so any caller can mark a victim's epochs 'claimed' (zeroing a single-epoch reward, or underflow-reverting and permanently bricking claims once ≥2 epochs have elapsed).
verifier.mechanism_class: view/mutating mismatch — the 'mark claimed' state write is decoupled from the payout (adapted from Velodrome's view earned())
verifier.impact: Permissionless, zero-cost, repeatable freezing/zeroing of all claimable community rewards for any/all depositors; irrecoverable without a contract upgrade.
verifier.human_review_required: confirm CommunityRewards is deployed/in-scope; judge High-vs-Medium (rewards-griefing)
verifier.human_review_focus: confirm CommunityRewards is live/in-scope; High-vs-Medium (rewards-griefing) is the residual human judgment
verifier.self_remediation: none — a bricked claim is irrecoverable without a contract upgrade
attacker_does_not_control: the victim's accrued balance / reward amount

function_map.why_it_matters: mutates tokenClaimedPerEpoch without paying out — the griefing primitive
the only real payout path: calls earned() then transfers and advances lastEarn

verifier.attacker_model: Any unprivileged EOA with no setup calls earned(rewardToken, victim) directly.
exploit_steps: Protocol runs ≥1 epoch so the victim has accrued rewards (tokenRewardsPerEpoch notified).
Attacker (any EOA) calls earned(rewardToken, victim).
earned() writes tokenClaimedPerEpoch[victim][token][ts] += reward but transfers nothing and does not advance lastEarn.
Single eligible epoch: the victim's later getReward() computes reward = share − claimed = 0 → victim receives nothing.
≥2 elapsed epochs: the running-accumulator subtraction reward -= tokenClaimedPerEpoch[ts] underflows and reverts → the victim's getReward() reverts forever (permanently bricked).
